matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.

passages.quote:
This notice should be read in conjunction with MGN 658 (M+F) the merchant shipping and fishing vessel (control of noise at work) regulations 2007 and MGN 636 (M) amendment 2 the merchant shipping and fishing vessel (health and safety at work) regulations 1997 and ILO work in fishing convention health and safety responsibilities. MGN 587 (F) amendment 1 ILO work in fishing convention health and safety responsibilities.

Notice to:

all ship and fishing vessel owners

operators and managers

other employers of seafarers

masters, officers and ratings of merchant ships

skippers and crew of fishing vessels

small commercially operated vessels

yachts with paid crew
